notes.title: Game Server Toolbox Development Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today we wanted to give you an update on the progress of the upcoming Game Server Toolbox Update.

We are still hard at work on the update. Since the Windows 10 May update will be coming out shortly, we decided to wait and make sure everything works with the newest .net framework and version of windows.

This version of Game Server Toolbox has been re-coded from the ground up as we are moving back to the way things were done originally before valve made us remove the ability of the software that automatically downloads and installs the server files using SteamCMD. This is why it is taking us so long. 

To make sure we do not violate any of Valve’s Terms, we will disable that feature on the Steam Version of Game Server Toolbox. However, anyone who has purchased the Steam Version of the software will automatically get a free license to the non-steam version of the Software.

We appreciate the patience you guys have and just want to let you know we are still working on the project and have not given up!

In other news, we are still working on the forums and website, but since our team has shrunk (just me now) I am prioritizing my time into the development of the project. I am in it for the long haul!

Regards,
SectorByte Solutions

notes.title: Game Server Toolbox Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Todays update brings some new features to the Server Control Panel along with some redesigns and fixes. See the changelog below.

- Redesigned the Server Control Panel
We completely redesigned the Server Control Panel to make way for some feature additions coming in the near future. It also features our upcoming light theme. We have added a resource monitor, console output, and logs to the server panel. Currently, the resource monitor displays the current resource usage for the entire system. The planned outcome for that is to only display the resource usage of the server. The console output box is for servers that have console output. We plan on hiding any server consoles that pop up after starting a server to minimize window clutter. The console output will then be redirected to that box. The log tab contains basic log entrys like if the server was started, stopped, or crashed. We plan on expanding the logging ability in the future for Game Server Toolbox Remote.

- Added Server Crash Detection
This is a very important feature that will be rolled out in 3 stages. This update contains the first stage of the feature. It will detect if the server has crashed and make a log entry. Right now, it is limited to only when the Server Control Panel is open, but the next stage will incorporate that monitoring system to a background process allowing the feature to work when the Server Control Panel is close.

- Redesigned the Early Access Dialog
We redesigned the dialog and made it only show once as we want to decrease the number of windows on startup. The dialog also features our new light theme and a new message.

- Redesigned the Video Tutorial Dialog
We redesigned the dialog and features our new light theme. We also fixed two issues. One, the video would still play on close, and two, the video would start in the middle rather the beginning.

- Fixed error when refreshing the Server Profile List when the user had no uploaded profiles.
- Fixed issue where if you had multiple servers, only the first servers settings would load in the Server Control Panel regardless of what server you selected to open.

We said we would have some new server profiles coming this week and we will! We wanted to get this update out before we start uploading the Server Profiles to the community. We will post an announcement when the profiles have been uploaded. That should be in the next few days.

So, what and when is the next update? As we said in the last announcement, we are going to focus on the Server Control Panel and bring more features to that in addition to uploading more Server Profiles. That update should be out in 2-3 weeks as usual if everything goes to plan.

Did you know you can follow our development progress on Trello? Check it out here!
https://trello.com/b/CS7Zc6fN/game-server-toolbox

That is about it for this one! Remember, if you have any questions or need help, feel free to email us a support@sectorbytesolutions.com as we would be happy to help!

notes.title: Game Server Toolbox Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Todays update introduces a few follow up feature to the last update. Please see the changelog below.

- Added Database Upgrade Tool
The Database Upgrade Tool is an easy way to update Game Server Toolboxs Database to the latest version without losing your servers, server files, server profiles, and settings.

- Added Server Profile Filter
The Server Profile Filter is an easy way to search the server profiles list by a custom text or game search.

- Added Port Forwarding Information Dialog
The Port Forwarding Information Dialog is a window that pops up after the server creation process giving you instructions on what ports need top be forwarded for your server. It also contains a helpful link that brings you to a website that shows you how to port forward on your router with pictures.

- Added Server Profile Manager
The Server Profile Manager allows you to manage and upload server profiles. You can create and upload a server profile form an existing game server or delete a currently uploaded profile. This feature is great for the community to start adding more server profiles to the list!

- Added Windows Version Detection
Windows detection warns the user if he or she is running the software on a operating system other than windows 10. Game Server Toolbox has not been tested on operating systems other than windows 10. But we do plan on expanding support to other operating systems in the future.

- Added Loading Dialog
The Loading Dialog informs the user of the startup process of Game Server Toolbox as it can take a second or two to start up.

- Added Early Access Dialog
The Early Access Dialog was added to remind people that Game Server Toolbox is still in development and is not the final product. It also asks users to kindly report the bugs to us.

- Added Video Tutorial Dialog
The Video Tutorial Dialog showcases our latest overview and tutorial of Game Server Toolbox.

Thats it for this update! For the next few weeks we will be working on adding more official server profiles and a video tutorial on how and where to download server files if they are not available in the Steam client.

This means you may not see a content update from us for 2-4 weeks as adding server profiles does not require an update to Game Server Toolbox.

As always, if you need support we are here to help! Just send us an email at support@sectorbytesolutions.com and we would be happy to help you!

Also, Game Server Toolbox is on Trello! Track the development progress here!
https://trello.com/b/CS7Zc6fN/game-server-toolbox

notes.title: Big Game Server Toolbox Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

The day has come! Today we released the long-awaited update to Game Server Toolbox. This update features a completely redesigned and recoded version of Game Server Toolbox. We scrapped the old version as we realized that we wanted to add more complex features to Game Server Toolbox than originally planned. Here is the change log.

Game Server Toolbox July 2018 Overview and Tutorial:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kx7M5wQ2m3c

- Recoded Game Server Toolbox from the ground up.
- Redesigned Game Server Toolbox from the ground up.
- Moved data storage from XML files to a Local SQL Database File.
- Redesigned the SectorByte Solutions Login and Create Account forms.
- Added 2 Factor Authentication.
- Added Device remembering.
- Redesigned the Game Server Toolbox Activation form.
- Updated the Game Server Toolbox activation experience to allow for 1 click Activation.
- Sped up the login process for remembered deceives.
- Redesigned the Setup form.
- Updated the Setup Process.
- Added Logging System for better error logging.
- Redesigned the Home Tab.
- Added Favorite Servers System.
- Added Favorite Servers List on the Home Tab.
- Added Notification System for Game Server Toolbox Events.
- Added Notifications List to Home Tab.
- Added System Resources Monitor to the Home Tab.
- Redesigned the Local Server Tab.
- Redesigned the Server Panel form to allow for Server Profiles.
- Redesigned the Server Files Tab.
- Redesigned the Add Server Files form to allow for Server Profiles.
- Updated the Add Server Files Process to allow for Server Profiles.
- Redesigned the Create Local Server form to allow for Server Profiles.
- Updated the Local Server creation process to allow for Server Profile usage.
- Temporarily removed the Port Forward Information form. (Will return in a future update. To get the ports that need to be forwarded open the Server Panel)
- Added Server Profiles Tab. (This is where you will download server profiles.)
- Added the ability to download official and user made server profiles for serve creation. (Right now, there are only official profiles but you will start seeing unofficial profiles popping up in the Server Profile Manager update in the future)
- Added the ability to report Server Profiles. (Report if the Server Profile is not working or for another reason.)
- Added Server Profiles Filter to allow for sorting by name, game, official, and or unofficial. (Will be functional in the next update.)
- Redesigned the Tools Tab to allow for more tools.
- Temporarily removed the Dependencies Manager from the Tools. (Will be returning in a future update.)
- Added Database Backup and Restore Tool. (This does not backup game server data! This backs up the Game Server Toolbox Database. Notifications, Server Files Paths, Local Game Server Configurations, etc...)
- Added Task Manager to the Tools Tab. (Not functional yet, but will allow you to see all the tasks ran by Game Server Toolbox)
- Redesigned the Settings Tab.
- Added SMTP Server Settings. (Enable and set these settings to receive your Notifications by email.)
- Added Game Server Toolbox Remote Settings. (Not functional yet but will allow you or whoever you give the Access Key and Connection IP to manage your servers setup in the upcoming Game Server Toolbox Remote Configuration Tool via the free Game Server Toolbox Remote client coming to Windows, macOS, IOS, and Android.)
- Redesigned the Help Tab.
- Added helpful links to the Help Tab.
- Added About Tab that allows you to see useful information about your installation and the Game Server Toolbox EULA.

Wow. That was a lot. Two months worth to be exact!

We will be adding the ability for users to create and upload their own Server Profiles in the coming updates as well and Game Server Toolbox Remote functionally.

We are also working on our own official forums to replace the Steam Discussions to allow for quicker and better support.

We also needed to do another account reset due to unforeseen circumstances with this Game Server Toolbox Update. We are really sorry about that because this is the 3rd time we did this.

Another note, since we changed how the data is stored, you will need to re-create any game server you currently have. Since we moved to database storage, it will be easier to perform in place upgrades to prevent any more resets.

We are also working one more Server Profiles for you guys since we only small selection of official Server Profiles. In the next update, you will be able to create Server Profiles from Local Game Servers you have made to help build up the Server Profiles database and expand the list.

DO NOTE! You can create any Game Server with Game Server Toolbox as it currently stands by selecting Other in the Add Server Files and Create Local Server forms. The only benefit of Server Profiles is it allows the user to download a premade server config so all they have to do is download the server files, port forward, and launch the game server instead of needing to fillin the details during creation proccess.

There is much more in the works, but this is about all we can say right now. Remember, if you need any help, feel free to email us at support@sectorbytesolutions.com and we would be happy to help you!

notes.title: Development Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I just wanted to give you an update on the development progress of Game Server Toolbox. It has been about a month since the last update. We have been hard at work on some new exciting features for Game Server Toolbox!

The first noticeable feature and you can see it in the below screenshot, is Server Profiles. We have designed a profile sharing system for the community to upload and share their profiles. We wanted to figure out a way to expand the game support for out users. Since this is a small development team we can only do so much in the terms of supporting new games. Now the community can step in and create profiles for ANY GAME that has a dedicated server feature. Once a person creates a profile manually for that game, they can upload it for other people to download. So, in other words, as long as the community is there, then Game Server Toolbox will stay alive for years to come!

Now, this dose not mean we will stop supporting games. There are two types of profiles. Official and Unofficial. Official Profiles are profiles created by us (SectorByte Solutions) and have been tested to work. Unofficial profiles are profiles created by other users. Those profiles have not been tested and we offer no support for those profiles. Check out the screenshot below!



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31634356/40bd7f30660bc58fc812ac3fb582eb25753003ad.jpg[/img]



The second feature is Game Server Toolbox Remote. This feature will allow the user to share their server with other users. There is a permission system for this so you can define what a user can and can’t access. So, for example, I want the user the only be able to restart the server, you can set the permissions to do just that.

The user would need to download a free version of Game Server Toolbox AKA Game Server Toolbox Remote and enter the Connection IP and Access Key to your Game Server Toolbox Installation. Then then will be able to see and access the servers and features you have set via permissions. Please note that Game Server Toolbox Remote is nowhere near fished and ready to release. It will take some time but we will get there!

With those two big features said, we needed to redesign the software from the ground up. This is why there has been no updates. In addition to the features mentioned above, we added notifications and a registered tools tab with many new tools.

The notifications feature is where you will receive notifications on the home tab about your servers. For example, start, stopping and crashing notifications. You also have the option to set a SMTP server in the settings tab and receive those notifications via email.

The Tools Tab has been redesigned along with adding many new tools. There will be tools for Notifications and Game Server Toolbox Remote just to name a few. This will not be in the next update as we are still working on it but will be done soon.

Tthis is basically just a fraction of the changes coming in the next and future updates. I just wanted to touch base will you all and let you know what’s going on. On a separate note, we will be opening our official forums and will accepting new posts in the discussions. The reason behind this is that I don’t get notified when someone posts there and want to help you guys ASAP with any issues you may have. You can contact us there or by email support@sectorbytesolutions.com.

So, that’s it! I know, long update but waned to let you know what’s going on. Oh, most importantly, we should be releasing the next update that will have a majority of the features listed here in the next month or so. So, until next time, have a good week everyone!

notes.title: Game Server Toolbox v0.6 Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today we released an update that allows you to create custom servers. You can now create a custom server for non-supported and supported games. Unfortunately, at the moment, for non-supported games, you will need to input the settings yourself. We are going to make creating custom servers for non-supported games easier in the future by creating Game Server Profiles that you can download in-app for free. These profiles will contain the default values for the non-supported game server and take the guessing work out of it. It would then be setup just like any supported game server.

Now you are probably wondering, why cant we just support the game in the first place if we are going to make Game Profiles for them? The answer is because some games/tools are not available in the Steam client for download and can only be downloaded from SteamCMD. Since Valve will not allow us to use SteamCMD, this is why we are doing it the way we are. You would need to download the server files using SteamCMD and then add them in Game Server Toolbox. From there you can then create a custom game server and you would be up and running just like if you created a server for a supported game. It will be even easier when we release the profile for that game.

We will also allow the community to create and share their own Game Profiles to keep Game Server Toolbox alive if game support should ever stop.

I know that can sound confusing, it was are intention at first to have Game Server Toolbox download the server files from SteamCMD, but Valve did not like that so we had to adapt.

The next big thing is Video Tutorials! You can now see at the top right of some Tabs and Windows, a link to a Video Tutorial about that area/feature. Right now, we only have tutorials for the Settings Tab and Setup Window but will be adding more soon!

In addition, we fixed an issue where if you selected your game server it would not enable the Open Server button. Along with that, we re-formatted the home tab so it looks less like a block of text.

Lastly, we are preparing to introduce a new account system. Since GDPR launched we needed to start redesigning our account system as it will not scale well at its current state with the requirements GDPR puts on us. We need to better implement features like data transfer, account deletion and etc. to make it scale better. These features are exsiting currently, but where implemented in a rush to comply with GDPR. Unfortunately, this means at some point you will need to re-create your account. I know that may be an inconvenience for some of you, but we want to better implement those features and other security features to better protect your account beyond the GDPR requirements! We also need to make way for the Game Profile sharing/creating system. We expect a reset around mid to late June!

Thanks for your time and as always, if you ever have and questions comments or concerns, email us at support@sectorbytesolutions.com as we would be happy to help you!

notes.title: Game Server Toolbox v0.5! Big Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today we released v0.5 of Game Server Toolbox. This update introduces changes to how game servers are created to make way for the new custom game server creation update coming soon. With that said, you will need to re-create your game servers as there have been many changes to the config files. We also made it to where if we ever update config files again, you will have an option to upgrade them instead of re-creating your game server. There are many other features so check out the list below!

- Added Early Access Message on startup.
- Updated EULA.
- Added notice on the setup screen about selecting your Steam Library Folder. This is the biggest issue people are having as they are selecting the wrong folder. We are working on ways to make this an easier process.
- Redesigned the Home Tab to only show news since we moved the Early Access Message to its own window.
- Redesigned the Game Servers Tab to show more information about the game server and moved the server details to its own panel.
- Added Game Server Panel. You can now view all your server details in this panel. Some options are disabled for non-custom game servers to prevent the user from misconfiguring the server. You will be able to create a custom server in a future update to regain access to these settings.
- Added option to restore the default Startup Parameters.
- Added option to view the ports that need to be forwarded after creation of the server.
- Added server process detection. This will allow the status of the server to be more accurate as if the server crashes the status will change automatically. This will also make way for a planed feature of auto starting the server if it crashes and sends a message to the user via email or SMS.
- Added GUI Lock to make sure the user dose not start the server multiple times by accident.

notes.content:

Today we released a required update to Game Server Toolbox. This update dose away with the product key system and replaces it with a simple sign in to your SectorByte Solutions Account. notes.title: New Activation System for Offline Use, Next Update?
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

Today I released an update that has you activate Game Server Toolbox. You will receive a product key to activate Game Server Toolbox with so you do not need Steam running to use the software. This was a huge downfall for people that use the same Steam Account they purchased Game Server Toolbox with to Play on their servers. It would say they need to quit Steam on the other system to play. So now you do not need Steam to be running to use Game Server Toolbox. You will still need to launch Steam to download updates but other than that, you do not need Steam running.

This is a very simple process. All you need to do to create a Sector Byte Solutions Account is enter your email address and create a password in the activation window. Your account will be created and the Game Server Toolbox product key will be added to your account. The key will then automatically be copied to the Product Key field for activation. You will also receive an email with the product key for your records.

Another huge benefit of registering is you will then have access to free 24/7 support within your account. Simply email support@sectorbytesolutions.com or open a ticket from your Account. Support dose not cost anything but only covers our products and services (Game Server Toolbox) and not game/configuration support.

Now if you’re like me, I would be asking, well, what would happen if SectorByte Solutions ever disappeared or decide to stop the activation service? Will I be locked out of my purchase??? Simple, if there is ever a time where we need to shut down our online servers or go out of business, we would release an EOL patch that would address that. So, rest assured you will always have access to the software as long as Steam is around.

So, with all that out of the way. What’s next? Very exciting stuff actually. I am in the process of making it possible to create game servers for game that are not supported natively by allowing someone to create a custom server. This will allow you to use Game Server Toolbox to host game servers that are not on Steam. You will need to enter in some details manually for it to work but this just makes it possible to create game servers for games that Steam dose not have a dedicated server tool for.

That’s all I have for you now. Please let me know if you encounter any issues with the activation system so I can help you out. support@sectorbytesolutions.com

notes.title: BIG UPDATE! NEW GAME SERVER CREATION PROCCESS!
notes.content:
Hello,

Today I released an update to remove the requirement of logging into a Steam Account to download servers. Since that was against the guidelines (even though Valve approved the build and store page!) I have had to change the way servers are created. This means unfortunately, any created servers will no longer work.

The way it works now is that you must download the game or dedicated server tool using steam. This will download the server files needed for Game Server Toolbox to create your server. I have put together a list of supported games and what game/tool is required for it to show up on the list. You can view this using the link below.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/777180/discussions/0/1694917906656441903/

Also, another important link.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/777180/discussions/0/1694917906656464131/

So, with that out of the way, you will notice some supported game are no longer supported. This is because you could only get the files from SteamCMD and there is no tool you can download from the Steam Client. We are currently working on a way to get those games back to supported but will take some time.

I have completely re-written the entire application from scratch in 2 days’ time to accommodate the issue with not being able to use SteamCMD. There are a few know issues that I still need to take care of that are listed below, but please know I am working to fix these as you are reading this.

With the re-write, there is a completely new design. I think you guys will be happy with it. It eliminates the need for extra windows to create a server or view your server. It also allows for more viewing customization for people with bigger monitors. 

After the next few days have passed and have fixed some issues with the core application, I will again start working on new supported games.

That’s all I got for you now! Hope you enjoy the update! Post any questions in the discussions so I can help you out!

Known Issues:
You can not change the server parameters or ports after creation.
You cannot select your steam library on first launch causing the user to have to go to settings and causes 2 errors.

tags.feature: With the re-write, there is a completely new design. I think you guys will be happy with it. It eliminates the need for extra windows to create a server or view your server. It also allows for more viewing customization for people with bigger monitors.

tags.bug: You can not change the server parameters or ports after creation.
You cannot select your steam library on first launch causing the user to have to go to settings and causes 2 errors.
